detail: Current storeless matrix counts: 9 MCP clean starts, 3 MCP store refusals, 2 viewer clean starts, and 2 viewer store refusals. Browser evidence used Chromium via `npx playwright screenshot` at 1440x900. doc-viewer at :3001 rendered the Documentation heading and UI (target/browser-evidence/doc-viewer-populated-1440x900.png). ticket-viewer at :3002 and spec-viewer at :4002 both served blank white pages from their worktree static directories; ticket-viewer's visible ticket-tree selector timed out, so the mandatory browser gate is failed. Isolated external-root refusal probes exited 1 before binding: ticket-viewer: Failed to open ticket store ... workspace not initialized; spec-viewer: Failed to open spec store ... workspace not initialized. No refusal screenshot applies because neither process started an HTTP server. Managed `install-ctl start` was attempted first for ticket-viewer, spec-viewer, and doc-viewer, then worktree-local `cargo run --manifest-path memory-viewers/<viewer>/Cargo.toml` fallback supplied persistent endpoints for Chromium checks.
